text: I'd say governments are more responsible, because they can make laws and control big companies. Ordinary people can only do small things, like sorting rubbish or saving electricity. Having said that, individuals still matter, since the government can't change anything if people don't follow the rules. So I think both sides need to cooperate, but the government should lead.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.
tips.example: I'd say governments are more responsible

tips.en: Concession phrases show flexible thinking and strengthen the argument.
tips.kk: Келісу тіркестері ойдың икемділігін көрсетеді және дәлелді күшейтеді.
tips.ru: Выражения уступки показывают гибкость мышления и усиливают аргумент.
tips.example: Having said that, individuals still matter

questions.question: Who is more responsible for protecting the environment: individuals or governments?

text: I think many people feel that the problem is too big and one person can't change it. Others are simply busy with their own lives, so the environment isn't a priority. Also, the effects aren't always visible straight away, which makes it easy to ignore. Education could help a lot, especially if children learn about nature from an early age.

tips.en: Simple spoken linkers help you move smoothly from one idea to the next.
tips.kk: Қарапайым ауызекі байламдар ойдан ойға еркін өтуге көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Простые разговорные связки помогают плавно переходить от мысли к мысли.
tips.example: Others are simply busy with their own lives

tips.en: Natural word combinations show a higher level of vocabulary control.
tips.kk: Табиғи сөз тіркестері лексиканы жоғары деңгейде меңгергеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Естественные словосочетания показывают более высокий уровень владения лексикой.

questions.followUp: How could they be encouraged to care?
questions.question: Why do some people not care about environmental problems?

text: In big cities, yes, I think it could work. Cars cause a lot of pollution and traffic jams, and the centre would be much quieter and safer for pedestrians. Of course, there should be good public transport, otherwise people would be really annoyed. In my country, for example, the air in big cities is often bad in winter, so a ban might improve things.

tips.en: Conditional structures (if, otherwise, once) add complexity and precision.
tips.kk: Шартты құрылымдар (if, otherwise, once) жауапты күрделі әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Условные конструкции (if, otherwise, once) добавляют сложность и точность.
tips.example: otherwise people would be really annoyed

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: for example, the air in big cities is often bad in winter

questions.question: Do you think it's a good idea to ban cars in city centres?

text: It's hard to say, but I'm afraid it will get worse before it gets better. Temperatures are rising, and some areas may have less water. On the other hand, renewable energy is becoming cheaper, so maybe we'll rely less on coal and oil. I'm fairly optimistic, as long as countries really work together. I hope we can still protect nature for our children.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: On the other hand, renewable energy
